message_en: {term} must be a decimal number written like 1050.00: Western digits 0-9, an optional leading sign, a dot as the decimal separator and at most 28 digits, with no spaces, thousands separators, exponent or currency symbol.
message_ar: يجب كتابة {term} رقماً عشرياً بصيغة مثل 1050.00: أرقام غربية من 0 إلى 9، وإشارة اختيارية في البداية، ونقطة فاصلةً عشرية، وبحد أقصى 28 رقماً، دون مسافات أو فواصل للآلاف أو أُسّ أو رمز عملة.
note: path and term vary by field (F7): one issue per non-empty field of doc::DECIMAL_FIELDS that fails decimal::parse (contract rule 10); that field is absent for every other rule and the invoice is never exported

message_en: Self-billing invoices (specification identifier urn:peppol:pint:selfbilling-1@ae-1) are not supported; use urn:peppol:pint:billing-1@ae-1.
message_ar: فواتير الفوترة الذاتية (معرّف المواصفة urn:peppol:pint:selfbilling-1@ae-1) غير مدعومة؛ استخدم urn:peppol:pint:billing-1@ae-1.
note: process.specification_identifier, trimmed and defaulted, starts with urn:peppol:pint:selfbilling-1@ae-1 (contract rule 9, spec 5.2.7); the official aligned-ibrp-001-ae accepts it

message_en: The payment due date (IBT-009) of a credit note can only be exported inside payment instructions (IBG-16); add payment instructions, otherwise the due date is left out of the XML.
message_ar: لا يمكن تصدير تاريخ استحقاق الدفع (IBT-009) في الإشعار الدائن إلا ضمن تعليمات الدفع (IBG-16)؛ أضف تعليمات الدفع، وإلا فسيُحذف تاريخ الاستحقاق من ملف XML.
note: credit note (381/81) with IBT-009 and no payment_instructions: the CreditNote XSD has no root DueDate, so IBT-009 is written as PaymentMeans/PaymentDueDate of payment_instructions[0] (CI IBT-009 row; export::B::payment_means)

message_en: The invoice total VAT amount (IBT-110) is required when a VAT breakdown (IBG-23) is present: the VAT breakdown can only be exported inside it.
message_ar: إجمالي مبلغ ضريبة القيمة المضافة في الفاتورة (IBT-110) مطلوب عند وجود تفصيل ضريبة القيمة المضافة (IBG-23)، لأن التفصيل لا يُصدَّر إلا ضمنه.
note: vat_amount empty while tax_breakdown is non-empty: the document-currency TaxTotal is written only with IBT-110 and TaxTotal/TaxAmount is XSD-mandatory (contract 0.2.1); suggested value xpath_round2(sum of tax_breakdown[#].tax_amount), the IBT-110 ibr-co-14 accepts, when every IBT-117 parses; an invalid IBT-110 is AE-FMT-001's

message_en: The tax accounting currency (IBT-006) is required when a currency exchange rate (BTAE-04) is given: the exported exchange rate must name its target currency.
message_ar: عملة المحاسبة الضريبية (IBT-006) مطلوبة عند تحديد سعر صرف العملة (BTAE-04)، لأن سعر الصرف المُصدَّر يجب أن يحدد العملة المستهدفة.
note: exchange_rate parses and tax_currency is empty: TaxExchangeRate/TargetCurrencyCode is XSD-mandatory (S7); no official rule requires IBT-006 for an AED invoice (XSD audit)

message_en: Payment card information (IBG-18) needs the card's primary account number (IBT-087, masked to its last 4 to 6 digits).
message_ar: تتطلب معلومات بطاقة الدفع (IBG-18) رقم الحساب الأساسي للبطاقة (IBT-087) مقنّعاً بحيث تظهر آخر 4 إلى 6 أرقام فقط.
note: a card with holder_name or network_id and no primary_account_number: CardAccount/PrimaryAccountNumberID is XSD-mandatory and no official rule requires it (XSD audit); NetworkID gets the NA placeholder

message_en: This field contains a character that XML 1.0 cannot carry (a control character such as U+0001, or U+FFFE or U+FFFF); remove it.
message_ar: يحتوي هذا الحقل على محرف لا يمكن تمثيله في XML 1.0 (محرف تحكم مثل U+0001، أو U+FFFE أو U+FFFF)؛ احذفه.
note: path varies by field (F7): one issue per string field the exporter can write (rules::platform::each_exported_string) whose trimmed text holds U+0000-U+0008, U+000B, U+000C, U+000E-U+001F, U+FFFE or U+FFFF; such a document cannot be serialised, so this rule keeps export from failing on a run without errors

message_en: The contract reference (IBT-012) is required when a contract value (BTAE-05) is given: the contract value can only be exported inside the contract reference.
message_ar: مرجع العقد (IBT-012) مطلوب عند تحديد قيمة العقد (BTAE-05)، لأن قيمة العقد لا تُصدَّر إلا ضمن مرجع العقد.
note: XSD audit: contract_value parses and contract_reference is empty; ContractDocumentReference/ID is XSD-mandatory and no official rule requires IBT-012 (ibr-094 only counts it)

message_en: The document totals (IBG-22) are missing: at least the amount due for payment (IBT-115) is required.
message_ar: إجماليات المستند (IBG-22) مفقودة: مطلوب على الأقل المبلغ المستحق للدفع (IBT-115).
note: XSD audit: no LegalMonetaryTotal amount (IBT-106 to IBT-109, IBT-112 to IBT-115) parses, so the XSD-mandatory LegalMonetaryTotal cannot be written; ibr-012 to ibr-015 need the element and ibr-co-15 passes when IBT-200 is true

message_en: {term} must be a calendar date written YYYY-MM-DD.
message_ar: يجب أن يكون {term} تاريخاً تقويمياً مكتوباً بالصيغة YYYY-MM-DD.
note: path and term vary (F7): a credit note's IBT-009 (PaymentMeans/cbc:PaymentDueDate, written when there are payment instructions) and every IBT-177 (cbc:InstallmentDueDate) are xsd:date but outside the ibr-073 context; checked as YYYY-MM-DD with a year from 0001 and a real day (XSD audit)

message_en: {term} uses the year 0000, which the UBL 2.1 schema does not allow; enter the real date.
message_ar: يستخدم {term} السنة 0000 التي لا يسمح بها مخطط UBL 2.1؛ أدخل التاريخ الصحيح.
note: path and term vary (F7): the ibr-073 dates (IBT-002, IBT-007, an invoice's IBT-009, IBT-026, IBT-072, IBT-073, IBT-074, IBT-134, IBT-135); ibr-073 casts with XML Schema 1.1, which accepts the year 0000, while the UBL 2.1 XSD is validated as XML Schema 1.0, which does not (XSD audit)

message_en: The issue time (IBT-168) has a time zone offset beyond ±14:00, which the UBL 2.1 schema does not allow; enter the real offset.
message_ar: يتضمن وقت الإصدار (IBT-168) فرق توقيت يتجاوز ±14:00، وهو ما لا يسمح به مخطط UBL 2.1؛ أدخل فرق التوقيت الصحيح.
note: XSD audit: an otherwise valid time with the offset ±14:01 to ±14:59; ibr-119 (castable as xs:time, Saxon) accepts it and the UBL 2.1 XSD (XML Schema 1.0) bounds the offset at ±14:00; that is the whole measured difference (5,040 combinations), every other invalid time is ibr-119's
